SAN FRANCISCO WEDDING DJ

San Francisco DJs

Why us?
If you are looking for a San Francisco DJ, then you’ve come to the right place. We come highly recommended by many entertainment and party service providers in the San Francisco and surrounding areas! The reason for our awesome reputation is that we offer reliable and professional DJ services for events such as

Weddings
Private parties
Corporate events
Bar/Bat Mitzvah
School dances
and a whole lot more!

We’ve been around the city
We’ve done events at

Alamo Square
Baker Beach
Blondies Bar
Carnelian Room
Chenery House
Claremont Hotel
Cliff House
Crissy Fields
Eagle’s Point at Lands End
Exploratorium  
Fairmont Hotel Penthouse
Four Seasons
Golden Gate Golf & Country Club
Golden Gate Park
Hilton San Francisco
Holiday Inn Fisherman’s Wharf
Hyatt San Francisco
Irish Cultural Center
Kensington Elks Lodge

Moscone Center
Muir Woods
Omni San Francisco Hotel
Pan Pacific Hotel
Point Bonita Lighthouse
Queen Anne Hotel
Ritz Carlton San Francisco
Rubye Skye Nightclub
San Francisco Yacht Club
San Francisco Zoo
SBC Park
Sir Francis Drake Hotel
Temple Emanu-El
The Marriott San Francisco
The Presidio
Top of the Mark
Westin St. Francis
Yerba Buena Center

We offer our professional services not only in the San Francisco Bay Area and surrounding counties but all throughout Northern California.
We’ll contact you within 24 hours after booking to arrange a meeting and discuss all of the finer details. We’ll make sure that everything goes smoothly on the day! We pride ourselves on providing a personal touch, and on interacting with our clients throughout the whole booking process.
Thanks to us, your event will be even better than you expected, so be prepared to have your guests demanding an encore!
Scroll down to find some links to help you narrow your search so that we can get this show on the road!
We really hope that you found our website helpful but if you have any questions, don’t hesitate to contact us!

Professional DJs in the Bay Area
We are your top choice for a San Francisco DJ. We offer reliable and professional services not only in the San Francisco Area but throughout the surrounding counties.
Call Chris for a chat on how we can make your event unforgettable:
415-350-5474
